description: Source code for Mach-O file identification and hashing functions, including CRC and MD5 calculations, and parsing Mach-O headers and load commands.

classes.name: MachoID
classes.description: Class for identifying and hashing Mach-O files, extracting UUIDs and dylib identifiers.

methods.name: UpdateCRC
methods.description: Calculates CRC (Adler-32) checksum over given bytes.

methods.name: UpdateMD5
methods.description: Updates MD5 hash with given bytes.

methods.name: UUIDCommand
methods.description: Retrieves UUID command from Mach-O header.

methods.name: IDCommand
methods.description: Retrieves ID command (dylib info) from Mach-O header.

methods.name: Adler32
methods.description: Calculates Adler-32 checksum of Mach-O header.

methods.name: MD5
methods.description: Calculates MD5 hash of Mach-O header.

methods.name: WalkHeader
methods.description: Walks through Mach-O header and load commands, invoking callback.
